I have investigated the issue where the link to the forum (`grand-challenge.org/forum`) is broken. After searching the codebase, I found that there is no hardcoded link to the forum in the templates or Python files. The forum link is rendered dynamically from the `Page` model in `app/grandchallenge/core/templates/site.html` via the following loop: ```html {% for page in pages %} {% if not page.hidden %}
  • {% firstof page.display_title page.title %}
    • {% endif %} {% endfor %} ``` Since the forum link is a database-driven `Page` object, the link is broken because the entry in the database points to a non-functional URL. To resolve this issue, an administrator should: 1. Log in to the Django administration interface. 2. Navigate to the "Pages" section. 3. Either delete the "Forum" page or update its URL to a valid destination. Because this is a data-level issue and not a code-level issue, no changes to the source code are required to fix the broken link.
